name: Berlin Circus Festival
description: The 12th edition of Berlin Circus Festival pushes the boundaries of contemporary circus, mixing cabaret, dance, acrobatics, aerial work, and juggling with a political and aesthetic edge. Long past elephants and sawdust, this festival embraces circus as a live art form in dialogue with technology and contemporary performance. Expect experimental formats, genre hybrids, and a program that treats the body as material rather than spectacle.
